title: Sunday, Nov 15
updated: Sat Nov 14, 4:00 PM · HuntStand + forecast · tap any stand for route + reasons
why: Coldest, calmest dawn of the week: 28°F at first light (freeze warning 1-8 AM), NW 4 mph (gusts ~9), clear, pressure rising (29.55 → 29.66). HuntStand activity 83 at 6-7 AM and 86 at 8-9 AM, so your best stretch fits before the 9:30 firearm break. Top pick #15: NW is its best wind, and Joe saw Bullwinkle from #15 Friday evening at the far edge of the select cut. Walk in from the Parking Pond down the field strip past #12A (~720 yd) to stay off the #16 trail. Backups: #30 (deer on its W side Saturday; NW fine early, it turns NNW after 9 when you're leaving anyway), #22, #5. ⚠️ Sunday: no firearms 9:30-12:30 (bow is fine). Sunday EVENING scores are the best of the week: 91 from 3-5 PM. QUARTERING AWAY: aim behind the near shoulder.
legal: No firearms 9:30 AM-12:30 PM. Bow is legal through the break.

stands.name: #30 two-person metal stand
stands.note: N (confirmed); 2-person; over "the twin pond" field; rifle/muzzleloader favorite; tough for archery
stands.bad: N (scent onto the travel route behind), S, SE, E
stands.info: FAVORITE (Nov 14). Two-person metal ladder on a tall pine (sways in high wind) with a big platform: room to stand and walk in front of the seat, so you can stand and shoot S around the tree. Shots in every direction, easy 200 yd. Rifle only. Built to face N over the twin pond, but since the cut most action is LEFT and BACK LEFT (W/SW): the W gully, and a travel route behind the stand from the SE heading W across #28's field to Duke Forest. Best wind W (scent goes E, off both the twin pond and the route behind); WNW/NW good; N is worst. Sees #21 (NNE ~240 yd) and the #12 corn/box/ladders (SW ~300 yd) plus Bobby's driveway: know where people are first. Out if anyone's duck hunting the twin pond. GPS Nov 14 (±8 yd): 36.19988, -79.26999.

promo.title: Quail hunting on Bobby's preserve
promo.sub: Pen-raised quail · open now through Mar 31
lines: Bobby raises quail, and the property is a licensed controlled hunting preserve, so members can hunt his banded, pen-raised birds.
Preserve season: Oct 1 – Mar 31. No daily bag limit on preserve birds.
Wild (unbanded) quail follow the regular season: Nov 21 – Feb 28, 6 a day.
Gear: 12-gauge or 20-gauge, brush pants. Blaze orange during deer gun season.
Ask Bobby to set up a hunt.
